en.name: Walnuts
en.summary: Walnuts keep 2–4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, 9–12 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F), whether in the shell or out of it. Walnut oil is among the most fragile of any nut, so cold storage is not optional if you are keeping them for more than a few weeks.
en.pantry: 2–4 weeks from purchase, sealed, cool, dark and dry. Walnuts carry a very high proportion of polyunsaturated fat, the kind that oxidises fastest, and that is why they turn bitter sooner than almost anything else in the nut bowl. The shell slows this but does not stop it, which is why the same short window applies either way. Keep them out of the sun and away from the hob, and in an opaque container rather than a clear jar.
en.fridge: 9–12 months from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in an airtight container. This is the ordinary home for walnuts in any kitchen that uses them for baking rather than by the handful — a few weeks becomes the better part of a year, simply because low temperature slows the oxidation of the fat. Seal them properly: walnuts are oily and absorbent, and they take up fridge smells fast.
en.freezer: 24 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Walnuts freeze perfectly, holding almost no water, and they can be chopped or toasted straight from frozen. Freeze them in a bag with the air pressed out, or in a rigid tub, and split a large bag into portions so you are not opening the whole lot for a handful. This is the right answer for a sack bought in season.
en.thawing: No thawing needed — use them from frozen. Let the sealed bag come back to room temperature before opening if you have taken the whole lot out.
spoilage: A sharply bitter taste and a burning sensation at the back of the throat — classic walnut rancidity.
A smell of old cooking oil, crayons or paint rather than something sweet.
Kernels that look dark, shrivelled or oily on the surface.
Mould, a musty smell or insects in a jar that got damp.
tips: Treat walnuts as a fridge or freezer item; the cupboard window is genuinely short.
Taste one before baking — rancid walnuts ruin a cake and there is no rescuing it.
Store in an opaque airtight container; light drives rancidity as much as heat.
Buy in season and freeze the bulk rather than buying small packs all year.

faq.a: 2–4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, 9–12 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Should walnuts be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: Yes, unless you will finish them within a few weeks. Walnut oil is unusually fragile, and the fridge multiplies their life many times over.

faq.q: How can you tell if walnuts have gone bad?
faq.a: Eat one. Rancid walnuts are sharply bitter with a burn at the back of the throat, and the taste carries straight into anything you bake.

zh.name: 核桃
zh.summary: 核桃自購買日起放櫥櫃 2～4 週，4 °C 以下冷藏 9～12 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 24 個月，帶殼或去殼都一樣。核桃油大概是所有堅果裡最脆弱的，所以只要要放超過幾週，低溫保存就不是選配。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起 2～4 週。核桃的多元不飽和脂肪比例非常高，而那正是氧化最快的那一類，所以它發苦的速度幾乎是堅果盤裡最快的。殼能拖慢這件事，但擋不住，這也是為什麼帶殼與去殼適用同樣短的窗口。請避免日曬、遠離爐台，並且用不透光的容器而不是透明罐。
zh.fridge: 氣密容器放 4 °C 以下，自購買日起 9～12 個月。對任何拿核桃來烘焙、而不是一把一把吃掉的廚房來說，這就是它平常該待的地方——幾週變成大半年，原因單純是低溫拖慢了油脂氧化。請確實密封：核桃油多又會吸味，冰箱裡的氣味它接收得很快。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下，自購買日起 24 個月。核桃非常耐凍，幾乎不含水，可以直接從冷凍切碎或烘香。請壓出空氣密封裝袋或用硬盒，並把大包分成小份，免得為了一把而打開整包。產季買一大袋的話，這就是正確答案。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍，直接從冷凍用。整包拿出來的話，請維持密封回到室溫再打開。
spoilage: 嚐起來苦得很尖銳、喉頭還有一股刺刺的灼感——這是核桃油耗的經典特徵。
聞起來像久放的油、蠟筆或油漆，而不是帶甜的香氣。
果仁顏色變深、乾癟，或表面出油。
受潮的罐子出現霉、霉味或蟲。
tips: 把核桃當成冷藏或冷凍品；櫥櫃的窗口是真的很短。
烘焙前先吃一顆——油耗的核桃會毀掉一整個蛋糕，而且救不回來。
用不透光的氣密容器；光線催出油耗的力道和溫度一樣大。
產季買一大批冷凍，比整年零買小包實際。

faq.a: 自購買日起，放櫥櫃 2～4 週，4 °C 以下冷藏 9～12 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 24 個月。
除非幾週內吃完，否則要。核桃油特別脆弱，冷藏能把壽命拉長好幾倍。
吃一顆。油耗的核桃苦得尖銳、喉嚨後段會有灼感，而且這個味道會原封不動進到烘焙成品裡。
